mapper.insert: INSERT INTO complaint (id, order_id, user_id, type, content, images, status, idempotent_key, is_deleted, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{orderId}, #{userId}, #{type}, #{content}, #{images}, #{status}, #{idempotentKey}, #{isDeleted}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, user_id, type, content, images, status, idempotent_key, is_deleted, create_time, update_time FROM complaint WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT id, order_id, user_id, type, content, images, status, idempotent_key, is_deleted, create_time, update_time FROM complaint WHERE idempotent_key = #{idempotentKey} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
